title: Track receipt on invoice per purchase order line
summary: Receipt on invoice can now be set per purchase order line, not just per purchase order. Lines inherit the value from the header, which in turn inherits from a new vendor-level setting.
key_points: Adds a receipt on invoice setting per purchase order line
Introduces a vendor-level receipt on invoice setting shown on the Vendor Card
Lines inherit from the purchase header, which inherits from the vendor
New line column is hidden by default under personalization on the purchase order page
Upgrade code and upgrade tags added alongside the new fields
